biotools.summary: VigiBase is a global database of adverse event reports from 180+ WHO member countries. This resource is used to assess the cardiovascular toxicity risks associated with tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs) utilizing a cross-sectional analysis of the database’s reports.
